{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model EoW= [[File:EoW Carrot Cake Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Carrot Cake Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Carrot Cake Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK, EoW |other= |pronunciation= |type= |cost= |value= 40-120 [[Rupee]]s |location= |uses= Restoring [[Heart]]s |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Carrot Cakes''' are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Carrot Cake|Carrot Cakes|Series, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{EoW}} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Carrot Cakes are a type of [[Cake]] made by combining [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Goat Butter]], and either a [[Swift Carrot]] or an [[Endura Carrot]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their mild sweetness makes them enjoyed by even those who dislike [[Carrot]]. Regular Carrot Cake can be made by using one of each carrot, which can be eaten to restore seven [[Heart]]s in [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. Two other variations of Carrot Cake also exist, depending on which kind of [[Carrot]] is used to make them: *'''Hasty Carrot Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Carrot Cake}}
Grants a mid-level movement speed boost.
Even those who don't like carrots tend to enjoy the mild sweetness of this cake.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using a [[Swift Carrot]]. Eating one will grant [[Link]] a mid-level speed boost. They restore three of Link's [[Heart]]s and can also be sold for 40 [[Rupee]]s. *'''Enduring Carrot Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Carrot Cake}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Even those who don't like carrots tend to enjoy the mild sweetness of this cake.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using an [[Endura Carrot]]. Eating one will restore and overfill [[Link]]'s [[Stamina Wheel]]. They restore five of Link's [[Heart]]s and can also be sold for 100 [[Rupee]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Carrot Cake returns in {{TotK}} with an identical [[Recipe]]. It can be made in either a [[Cooking Pot]] or a [[Portable Pot]]. ==={{EoW|-}}=== A Carrot Cake appears in a [[House]] in [[Kakariko Village]]. A slice of the Cake can be seen on the [[Table]] inside the House, while the rest of the Cake sits on a cutting board in the rear left corner of the House. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:EoW Carrot Cake Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{EoW|-}}}}A slice of Carrot Cake ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cake * Carrot Stew * Food * Meal }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Carrot Cake}}
